name: Call workspace UI
on:
  pull_request:
    paths: ['app/**', 'components/**', 'lib/**', 'scripts/verify-call-ui.mjs', '.github/workflows/call-ui.yml']
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['app/**', 'components/**', 'lib/**', 'scripts/verify-call-ui.mjs', '.github/workflows/call-ui.yml']
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  browser:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Install pinned browser harness
        run: |
          npm install --prefix /tmp/lt-browser --no-audit --no-fund --ignore-scripts playwright@1.55.1
          node /tmp/lt-browser/node_modules/playwright/cli.js install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Verify responsive setup and navigation
        env:
          PREVIEW_NO_AUTH: '1'
          VERCEL_ENV: development
          NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: ''
          NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY: ''
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          pnpm dev --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3100 > test-results/dev-server.log 2>&1 &
          server=$!
          trap 'kill "$server" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
          for i in $(seq 1 90); do curl --fail --silent http://127.0.0.1:3100/api/health >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done
          node scripts/verify-call-ui.mjs
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: call-workspace-ui-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: test-results/
          retention-days: 14
